items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions Chano Pozo as Al McKibbon's roommate; Interviewee does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Chano Pozo.

ctx.x: Recording-wise. Okay, but you didn’t stay. What’s particularly interesting about this date is you got Al McKibbon on bass. Al was – I know Al from when he played with Diz, playing with – he used – I interviewed him for the same program. He said he was Chano Pozo’s roommate when they toured. And then, of course, George Shearing and all that. But, to me, he was going to bring that Latin – definitely a Latin bottom to it.
I don’t know who got him – who engaged him on that, but it probably was Stix or somebody. It could have been Dick Bock. Dick Bock was the head of the Pacific Jazz label.
